rationale: Starter fluid sprayed into the air filter was what got one of the ATVs running during the pre-sim triage of a fleet that mostly would not start. The brief's lesson is to bring starter fluid.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.1 Technical failures, lines 542-547, 'Lesson for Hypatia III' column; Flashline corroboration: SRC-flashline-crew-reports, FLASHLINE-16 DAILY REPORT 05-07-2024 (ATV Startup item)
